notes: Sun's conjecture is R-sequenceability of abelian groups of odd order, a case of the Friedlander-Gordon-Miller conjecture proved by Alspach, Kreher and Pastine, Australas. J. Combin. 67 (2017) 11-24. A228762.lean checks witnesses for Z_9, Z_15, Z_21, Z_3xZ_3, Z_3xZ_9, Z_5xZ_5 by kernel evaluation (no axioms). Outside Lean: the Alspach-Kreher-Pastine theorem (cited).

sources.cite: B. Alspach, D. L. Kreher, A. Pastine, The Friedlander-Gordon-Miller conjecture is true, Australas. J. Combin. 67(1) (2017) 11-24
sources.what: every abelian group with trivial or non-cyclic Sylow 2-subgroup is R-sequenceable
